title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-08-03
content:
Weekly update: Private Deployments engineering (2026-08-03)

Owners/recipients: eng-private-deployments, solutions-eng, support triage
Prepared by: Daniel Chen (owner)
Collaborators: Aisha K., Marina L., Ben F., Luis O.
Status: in_review

TL;DR:
- Progress on VPC installer improvements (support for shared VPC subnets) and on-prem agent stabilization.
- Two customer blockers remain high priority: Acme Corp on-prem install (CS-1289) and BetaBank VPC peering/route propagation (JIRA-2314).
- Rollout plan for private observability agent updated; new rollout scheduled on 2026-08-10.

Highlights this week:
1) VPC / Networking
- Added support for shared-VPC subnet mapping to the installer (PR #142). Installer can now accept a mapping file with host-project subnets to attach endpoint ENIs. Basic e2e tests passing in staging. (Marina).
- Follow-ups: need to verify cross-project IAM permissions with security team before enabling for GA customers. Ticket JIRA-2378 opened for exact permission set and doc updates.

2) On-prem Agent / Installer stability
- Fixed a race in the kv-cache binder that caused agent to OOM under heavy parallel init on 48-core nodes (root cause: double-register of cache shard). Patch deployed to nightly channel; preliminary tests show memory usage down ~30%. (Ben).
- Installer now detects incompatible docker runtimes and emits clearer actionable messages (logs + troubleshooting steps). Reduces noisy support back-and-forth. (Luis).

3) Observability and Logs
- Updated agent to support forwarding trace IDs in env when platform trace sampling is enabled. This unblocks correlation between user requests and private logs for customers using our tracing pipeline. Rollout plan in place. (Aisha).

4) Security & Compliance
- Completed candidate changes for FIPS-compatible crypto provider for the private control plane. Documentation draft in CONF-Private-Install-Runbook. Need internal review from security before offering to customers.

Customer blockers (current, high priority):
- CS-1289 — Acme Corp on-prem install failing during step "seed-model-cache". Symptoms: seed job stalls at 35% and never recovers; observed 503 from local nginx in containerized gateway. Current status: engineering has remote access; reproducer captured (logs + core dump). Next step: run instrumented seed in isolation to confirm race reported in kv-cache binder patch fixes it. Owner: Ben. ETA: 2026-08-05.
- JIRA-2314 — BetaBank VPC peering / route propagation. Their egress path to our regional dedicated control plane is intermittently blackholed after peering. Hypothesis: BGP route refresh timing + asymmetric firewall rules. Action: Solutions Eng to run traceroute + BGP dumps with customer; infra to prepare temporary proxy in us-east-2 for mitigation. Owner: Marina. ETA: 2026-08-06.
- JIRA-2387 — Customer telemetry not appearing in platform from private deployment (low volume but missing traces). Likely misconfigured forwarder auth. Owner: Aisha. ETA: 2026-08-07.

Standup snippets / daily logs (abridged):
- Mon 2026-08-03: Quick sync — prioritized Acme reproduce, blocked on reproducer completeness. Ben to attach core and run instrumented seed. Marina to scope BetaBank network window.
- Tue 2026-08-04: Installer e2e run in staging passed (shared-VPC mapping). Noted flaky IAM test — security to confirm required service account roles.
- Wed 2026-08-05: Nightly agent build showed kv-cache regression fixed; memory profile OK. Begin controlled roll for non-production customers.
- Thu 2026-08-06: Observability forwarder auth fix merged to main; release candidate cut. Rollout scheduled to internal canaries on 2026-08-10.

Recent meetings (notes):
- 2026-08-03 Customer call — Acme Corp kickoff
  - Ran through install logs with customer. They share the same hardware profile as our reproducer. Customer agreed to run the instrumented seed; we will have a call Friday to review output. Action: Ben will join; SRE on stand-by.
- 2026-08-04 Oncall handover
  - Reviewed two infra incidents: one was a noisy retry loop in the installer (fixed), second was tracing missing in private control plane (workaround applied).
- 2026-08-05 Security review — FIPS provider
  - Security requested additional KMS integration tests and a clear migration path doc. Ownership: Security + Daniel. Due: 2026-08-14.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Should the installer default to shared-VPC disabled? Risk: enabling by default may require customers to open cross-project IAM earlier than expected. Proposal: keep opt-in until security signs off. (Action: Marina to write short proposal by 2026-08-07).
- KV cache durability guarantees for disconnected on-prem nodes: Are we comfortable with the current best-effort blackbox approach? Need product guidance on SLOs and expected behavior under network loss. (Action: Daniel + Product-private to sync 2026-08-11).

Action items (owner, due):
- Ben: Run instrumented seed job with Acme reproducer; verify kv-cache race fixed. Due 2026-08-05.
- Marina: Coordinate BGP dumps + traceroute with BetaBank; prepare temporary proxy plan. Due 2026-08-06.
- Aisha: Validate forwarder auth fix end-to-end and monitor internal canaries. Due 2026-08-07.
- Daniel + Security: Add KMS integration tests and migration doc for FIPS provider. Due 2026-08-14.
- Luis: Add clearer installer error hints for common docker/runtime issues and publish a short KB for support. Due 2026-08-09.

Risks / blockers to watch next week:
- Security sign-off for shared-VPC feature — if delayed, GA timeline slips by ~2 weeks.
- BetaBank network window scheduling — action depends on customer calendar; could delay mitigation.
- On-prem regressions: if the kv-cache fix does not hold under long-running loads, we need a patch release and communication plan for customers.

Planned for next week (2026-08-10 week):
- Controlled rollout of observability forwarder to internal canaries (2026-08-10). Monitor traces/metrics for 72h.
- Finish Acme reproduce verification; prepare patch release if fixed.
- Finalize shared-VPC IAM doc and decide opt-in default.
- Run long-duration load test for kv-cache on 48-core+ nodes for 7 days in staging.

Appendix: quick links and commands used this week
- Reproducer path: s3://private-deploy-reproducers/acme-cs-1289/
- Staging e2e job: ci/private-installer-e2e-staging (rerun with --shard 12)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-installer/pull/142
- Runbook draft: CONF-Private-Install-Runbook

Notes to self:
- Keep weekly notes short and include owners. When a customer blocker exists, mark it high priority in the support channel so oncall SREs are aware.
- Next weekly: check-in on BetaBank mitigation and kv-cache long-run results.

-- End of update --
